Wife Allegedly Mutilates Husband's Genitals in Meerut

In Meerut, a woman named Shabnam allegedly drugged her husband, Nadeem, with a substance in his coffee after suspecting him of talking to other men. While he was unconscious, she reportedly attacked him with a knife, causing injuries to his private parts. The victim has been hospitalized, and the police have taken the accused wife into custody.
